metadata.provenanceNote: Rolling seven-day publication assembled from approved official cinema sources.

films.descriptionZh: 一段黑白列车旅程中，女性的遗憾、渴望與希望被倾听。
一位寡居婦女與園丁相戀，遭子女阻撓與社會壓力。
films.descriptionEn: A well-off widow falls for a Thoreau-reading gardener, provoking her priggish children’s efforts to break the match and exposing the social pressures and emotional costs that surround their relationship.

films.descriptionZh: 两位医院同事与邻里在人群与灵性间流动相互慰藉。
films.descriptionEn: Roommates and hospital co-workers Prabha and Anu, along with their retired colleague facing homelessness, move through Mumbai in a film that shifts from slice-of-life realism to transcendental mysticism in rich color.

films.descriptionZh: 一次戀愛的消逝與重逢，主角在幻象與現實間抉擇。
通过阿维东的照片与人物，展现影像如何塑造当代文化与偶像。
films.descriptionEn: From world leaders to supermodels, the film follows Richard Avedon’s photographs and influence, showing how his images didn’t just reflect culture but actively shaped the modern, image-driven world.

films.canonicalTitle: Big Trouble in Little China - 35MM | The Surreal Nightmares of Screaming Mad George
films.displayTitle: Big Trouble in Little China - 35MM | The Surreal Nightmares of Screaming Mad George
films.descriptionZh: 卡车司机卷入旧金山华埠的超自然黑帮争斗与魔法对决。
films.descriptionEn: Jack Burton, an independent trucker, is pulled into a supernatural gang war in San Francisco’s Chinatown, battling sorcerers, bizarre fiends, and black magic in a colorful, effects-driven adventure.

films.descriptionZh: 哥譚式華麗改編，德古拉的欲望與復仇在豪華製作中被強烈呈現。
films.descriptionEn: An opulent, baroque take on Stoker’s tale that foregrounds piercing sexual ache and romantic longing, staging lavish gothic imagery and heightened performances as the narrative draws the novel’s erotic and tragic impulses to the surface.

films.descriptionZh: 一场家庭周末聚会演变成女儿精心操纵的心理折磨与猜谜游戏。
films.descriptionEn: A suffocating weekend at a country manor where an unhappily married couple and their assorted lovers are forced into a vicious guessing game orchestrated by their bitter, disabled daughter to sow dissension and psychological torment.

films.descriptionZh: 兒子最後在華沙維斯瓦河橋上的監視畫面出現後，父親展開不眠搜尋，動用自製船隻與無人機下水調查。
films.descriptionEn: After his teenage son is last seen on a surveillance camera on a bridge over Warsaw’s turbulent Vistula River, a father launches an all-consuming search, deploying homemade boats, drones, and underwater gear to find answers.

films.descriptionZh: 印第安纳城市的现代建筑成为情感表达场域，陌生人与建筑交织出沉静渴望。
一位八歲女孩在壓抑家庭與亡靈世界間游移的寓言式家庭劇。
跟随冲浪者寻找隐秘海浪，从加州到澳洲，鱼眼视角与迷幻配乐并进。
一曲唱片引发回忆，叙述者讲述被妖艳女子毁掉的人生。
films.descriptionEn: A down-on-his-luck pianist recalls a fateful roadside meeting with a femme fatale and the ensuing subjugation that led to a bleak, doom-laden spiral—an absurdist noir born from Hollywood’s Poverty Row.

films.descriptionZh: 在匈牙利广袤的草原上，古希腊神话被极简长镜头重述，成为对暴政与反抗的冥想。
films.descriptionEn: A hypnotic retelling of the Electra myth set on Hungary’s vast puszta, composed of a handful of intricately staged long takes that transform the ancient tale into a timeless meditation on tyranny and rebellion.

films.descriptionZh: 柏林一名少女遭遇意外后，母亲、妹妹與男友陷入如夢魘般的停滞哀伤。
一对外表完美的康涅狄格夫妻，生活因秘密和禁忌情感而分崩离析。
小说家托马斯·曼与女儿在战后德国展开一次充满冲突与反思的公路旅程。
钢琴家露西举家迁入乡间，希望缓和丈夫的严重倦怠，却在安顿前遭遇变故。
films.descriptionEn: Concert pianist Lucy moves her family to a country house hoping to ease her husband Philip’s severe burnout, but before they have a chance to settle in unexpected events begin to intrude on their attempt at recovery.

films.canonicalTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.displayTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.descriptionZh: 2029年，半机械化的少校追踪一个在信息海洋中诞生的神秘存在。
films.descriptionEn: In 2029 a cyborg Major tracks an omnipotent entity born in a sea of information—an ambiguous hacker or virus threatening world order—while the animation blends hand-drawn and CGI techniques to render her physical and existential journey.

films.descriptionZh: 一名自杀未遂者参加时间旅行实验，过往记忆碎片以错乱片段返现。
films.descriptionEn: After an unsuccessful suicide attempt, a man agrees to take part in a time-travel experiment that returns fragments of his past in disordered shards, blending subtle science fiction with a gentle love story to unsettling effect.

films.descriptionZh: 跨越近一世紀的三段式史詩，三個男人由慾望與遺產相連。
films.descriptionEn: A bold, passionate triptych spanning nearly a century of Spanish history, the film traces three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain, and inheritance, moving between historical periods to examine legacy and longing.

films.canonicalTitle: Leonora in the Morning Light + Q&A
films.displayTitle: Leonora in the Morning Light + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 画家莱奥诺拉·卡灵顿反抗社会期待，投身超现实主义并在墨西哥找到自我力量。
films.descriptionEn: Painter Leonora Carrington rebels against social expectations, joins the surrealist circle in Paris amid a tumultuous romance, confronts inner demons, and eventually flees to Mexico where she finds empowerment.

films.descriptionZh: 从黑暗家庭戏出发，影片化身梦魇般的心理迷宫与身份转换。
一名浪漫的編劇在巴黎午夜穿越到爵士年代，重新檢視人生選擇。
films.descriptionEn: A wistful screenwriter on vacation in Paris steps out one night and finds himself transported to the Jazz Age, encountering the bohemian freedom of Fitzgerald, Hemingway, Dali, and Picasso, which forces him to reevaluate his life choices.

films.descriptionZh: 2002年，密妮和卡麗正準備升上高三，密妮長期活在朋友的光環下。
films.descriptionEn: It’s 2002: best friends Minnie and Callie head into their senior year, with Minnie long living in the protective shadow of a charismatic friend as they confront the pressures of adolescence.

films.descriptionZh: 大萧条时代的纽约，小提琴家在成名与道德之间抉择。
films.descriptionEn: Set in 1930s New York amid the Depression, a gifted young violinist faces a chance at fame that forces him to choose between music and the temptations that could alter his future.

films.descriptionZh: 在特拉维夫屋顶的秘密对话中，以色列人揭露加沙大屠杀的系统设计与运作。
films.descriptionEn: Through secret rooftop conversations in Tel Aviv, Israeli filmmakers and journalists reveal the systems behind the calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza, drawing on the testimony of those who designed and operated them.

films.descriptionZh: 夜色中从特拉维夫楼顶拍摄，记录加沙平民伤亡与目标杀戮背后的系统。
紐約地鐵與街頭影像與母親書信交織的日記式影像詩。
films.descriptionEn: A diary-like film of New York subway stations and street corners paired with recitations of a mother’s fretful letters, offering a poignant portrait of the city and a touching, troubling meditation on maternal love and urban dislocation.

films.descriptionZh: 被囚十五年后重获自由的男人带着狂怒與复仇，展开一段黑暗且令人不安的报复旅程。
films.descriptionEn: After fifteen years imprisoned without explanation, a man is suddenly released and embarks on a brutal, vengeful odyssey that combines visceral set‑pieces, surreal dark humor, and unrelenting intensity.

films.descriptionZh: 漂泊少年闯入长途卡车的高压男性世界。
films.descriptionEn: Veneno, a rebellious drifter, hustles rides and sex at roadside diners until he convinces the taciturn long-haul trucker Muñeco to take him deeper into the hard-edged, hyper-masculine world of trucking.

films.canonicalTitle: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
films.displayTitle: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
films.descriptionZh: 一次在杜克·艾灵顿公寓的聚会，记录哈莱姆文艺复兴人物与文化的鲜活影像。
两名女性连环杀手藏身仓库，领袖与追随者之间爆发权力與忠诚冲突。
films.descriptionEn: Two young female serial killers take refuge in an abandoned warehouse to plot their next move; one struggles with leadership while the other vies to prove her devotion, testing power and loyalty.

films.canonicalTitle: Personal Problems | The Ravishing Cinema of Bill Gunn
films.displayTitle: Personal Problems | The Ravishing Cinema of Bill Gunn
films.descriptionZh: 由黑人藝術家團隊創作的元肥皂劇，呈現複雜的黑人生活與敘述權。
films.descriptionEn: An entirely African American–conceived ensemble drama born from a collaboration of pioneering Black artists, the film operates as a meta–soap opera that foregrounds Black storytelling, artistic autonomy, and layered social perspectives.

films.descriptionZh: 善良的美子照顾外孙，学写诗却在孙子陷入丑闻后遭遇失望与痛楚。
两对中年夫妻因失业与纪录片拍摄交织出关系纠葛、怨愤與伦理困境。
电视主持人追求创纪录节目，揭开一段媒体歷程與野心。
films.descriptionEn: Centered on To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen, the story follows his effort to make television history, tracing the ambitions and media maneuvers behind a high-stakes broadcast endeavor.

films.descriptionZh: 2006年，电视主持人克里斯·汉森试图创造电视历史。
films.descriptionEn: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history, pursuing a high-stakes media project that centers him as its driving public figure.

films.canonicalTitle: PRIVATE EVENT TODAY IN THEATER & COMMISSARY
films.displayTitle: PRIVATE EVENT TODAY IN THEATER & COMMISSARY

films.descriptionZh: 少年认出雇主之妻竟是多年前抛弃他的母亲，由此潜入家庭寻求了结或复仇。
根據真實拳擊手故事，描繪疫情下的職業與自我價值危機。
揭示美国军队历史中不为人知的一章。
films.descriptionEn: Uncovers a hidden chapter of American military history, exploring aspects of service and memory that have remained largely untold.

films.descriptionZh: 一部受佛洛伊德與達利影響的心理驚悚，夢境與記憶交織。
films.descriptionEn: A psychoanalytic thriller in which analyst Ingrid Bergman falls for an amnesiac patient while probing whether a murderer’s nature hides beneath his polished exterior; a famed dream sequence by Salvador Dalí intensifies the film’s delirium.

films.descriptionZh: 两名男子在列车上的偶遇促成互换谋杀的阴谋，一场紧张的复仇与追逐拉开序幕。
films.descriptionEn: A casual train encounter leads two men to agree to “swap murders,” setting off a tense chain of stalking, set-piece pursuit, and escalating consequences as one man becomes ensnared by the other’s designs.

films.descriptionZh: 一位无名摄像叙述者沿着污染的苏州河窥见城市阴暗面。
films.descriptionEn: Named for Shanghai’s polluted waterway, the film follows an unseen videographer who observes the city’s grubby underbelly, tracing how a motorcycle courier becomes ensnared in a kidnapping plot and a murder accusation.

films.descriptionZh: 一位美国畅销书作家在罗马宣传新作时，发现有人以书中恐怖场景复刻谋杀。
films.descriptionEn: An American author promoting a potboiler in Rome finds a murderer reenacting the ghoulish set pieces from his fiction; the film mounts a dizzying return to giallo with striking camera moves and a notorious razor-through-cotton image.

films.descriptionZh: 一段痛苦离婚引发与怪异疗法有关的致命暴力连锁。
films.descriptionEn: After a bitter divorce, a man grows suspicious of his ex’s experimental therapy when people on her enemies list are killed by eerie, asexual, dwarfish assassins, unraveling a brutal, nightmarish chain of events.

films.descriptionZh: 一部围绕迷恋与腐败展开的史诗式电影，呈现极具感染力的宗教与权力冲突。
films.descriptionEn: An intense, singular epic that stages obsession and corruption against a backdrop of religious and institutional conflict, crafted into a provocative cinematic spectacle.

films.canonicalTitle: The Draughtsman's Contract + Live Performance | Instruments of Desire
films.displayTitle: The Draughtsman's Contract + Live Performance | Instruments of Desire
films.descriptionZh: 17世纪庄园内，画师受雇描绘地产，画中细节揭露阴谋与谋杀疑云。
films.descriptionEn: In an exaggerated 17th-century England, a young draughtsman is hired to sketch an estate and, as his drawings accumulate, curious details emerge that may expose a labyrinthine mystery and a possible murder.

films.descriptionZh: 被南军拒绝的工程师为夺回被北军带走的火车，展开一场惊人追逐与滑稽闹剧。
希腊神话中的蛇发女妖的致命凝视在德国村庄蔓延，村民成石。
films.descriptionEn: Hammer turns to Greek mythology as a Gorgon’s fatal gaze petrifies residents of a German village circa 1910; an esteemed professor must overcome local interference to uncover and confront the she‑devil Megaera behind the stonings.

films.descriptionZh: 纪录片以混合幽默與情感的方式，追索混凝土作为纽约基石的故事与意义。
films.descriptionEn: John Wilson investigates concrete—the bedrock of New York City—seeking to make a definitive documentary, then adopts a Hallmark formula to broaden appeal, only to see his project and foundations literally and figuratively begin to crumble.

films.descriptionZh: 脱离电视秀后，导演探索以贺卡片式公式来纪录混凝土与日常美学的可能性。
films.descriptionEn: After ending his TV show, a filmmaker attends a workshop on writing Hallmark movies and then tries to apply that formula to a documentary about concrete, searching for a new creative outlet and approach.

films.descriptionZh: 一名女佣的到来将中产家庭的日常变成欲望与混乱的沸点。
films.descriptionEn: A young woman hired to help a middle-class household upends the family’s routine, turning the house into a boiling cauldron of lust as melodrama, morality, noir, and horror collide in a vice-like grip.

films.descriptionZh: 中年教授一夜邂逅画廊里的女模后，卷入自卫致命事件与掩饰，越查越陷。
films.descriptionEn: Alone over a holiday, a staid college professor glimpses a model in a gallery, shares a drink, and soon becomes embroiled in a self-defense killing and its cover-up—forcing him to investigate his own crime as clues tighten the noose.

films.descriptionZh: 记者追查神秘网上挠痒比赛，越挖越遭遇强烈阻力與驚人内幕。
films.descriptionEn: Journalist David Farrier uncovers a mysterious online tickling competition and, as he digs deeper, faces fierce resistance while unraveling a story stranger than fiction about the people and money behind it.

films.descriptionZh: 在布鲁克林，一位落魄的五十多岁母亲与女儿的年轻友人合谋拍片，名利与背叛交织成尖锐讽刺。

films.canonicalTitle: Two Seasons, Two Strangers preceded by Nagahama
films.displayTitle: Two Seasons, Two Strangers preceded by Nagahama
films.descriptionZh: 两段季节性相遇并行，夏日与冬日的爱情与对比被并置。

films.canonicalTitle: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
films.displayTitle: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
films.descriptionZh: 一名虔诚的杀手在妻逝后踏上保护子女的绝望旅程，同时面对信仰与暴力的冲突。
香港夜色中的小提琴家在街頭徘徊，幻象打亂她的時序記憶。
